facts.text: The serial line is opened at 9600 baud with a 0.5 s read timeout
The constructor resets the instrument and identifies it with '*IDN?'; it accepts the unit when the reply contains 'HEWLETT-PACKARD,6632B'
A measurement is read with 'MEAS:VOLT?;CURR?' and split into voltage and current
The source is set with 'SOUR:VOLT %.3f; CURR %u MA': voltage in volts with three decimals and current in milliamperes as an integer
Output enable writes 'OUTP:STAT 1' or 'OUTP:STAT 0'; 'OUTP:STAT?' reads the state
The native stop sets the output state to 0, clears the logging run flag and joins the logging thread
A measurement query takes about 109 ms
The upstream code charges and discharges a Li-ion battery, deriving the current from the battery capacity
The upstream oscillate() sets 15 V and 1000 mA before toggling the output
The display accepts mode NORM or TEXT and at most 14 characters of text
stop() calls isAlive(), a Python 2 Thread method
oscillate() iterates with xrange(), a Python 2 built-in
The package __init__ imports HP6632B with an implicit relative import
